name: White note ~Watashi no Choukyou Nisshi~
source:
Main character is a notorious trainer with many accomplishments. Just before graduating he is ordered to train innocent student council secretary.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-august-2005-saihate-no-ima.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角是一位臭名昭著的训练家，拥有许多成就。毕业前夕，他被命令训练无辜的学生会秘书。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-august-2005-saihate-no-ima.html]vndbreview[/url]]
